text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Only the best racers worthy of being part of the Ultimate Era have gathered to compete in the Arima Kinen, which marks the climax of Eishin Flash's three-year career.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As Eishin Flash remarks that winning first place today would cap her career off on the perfect note, I interrupt her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The schedule I cobbled together for her is sloppy at best, but it's filled with my intense hope that she'll keep racing.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: To my great relief, Eishin Flash is already determined to keep running. She gladly offers to make adjustments to the plan after the race.
